description.en: Government instruments that direct or support manufacturing investment — priority-investment designations, infrastructure budgets, permits, procurement and research targets — and the strategic projects they concern, traced stage by stage from announcement to any officially observed outcome.
description.zh: 引导或支持制造业投资的政府工具——重点投资认定、基础设施预算、许可、采购和研发目标——以及相关战略项目，从公告到官方观测结果逐阶段追踪。

role.en: Manufacturing gross value added as a share of GDP (NACE C).
role.zh: 制造业增加值占 GDP 比重（NACE C 门类）。

role.en: Monthly production volume of industry (NACE B–D, mining to energy supply).
role.zh: 工业月度产量指数（NACE B–D，采矿至能源供应）。

role.en: Exports of motor-vehicle enterprises (NACE C29) as a share of all exports.
role.zh: 汽车制造企业（NACE C29）出口占全部出口比重。

role.en: Annual change in real labour productivity per person employed.
role.zh: 按就业人员计算的实际劳动生产率年度变化。

role.en: Manufacturing share of regional gross value added, for regions where a project is located.
role.zh: 项目所在区域的制造业增加值占比。

role.en: SORS manufacturing share of GDP for Serbia (national definition).
role.zh: 塞尔维亚统计局口径的制造业占 GDP 比重。

role.en: SORS industrial production index for Serbia.
role.zh: 塞尔维亚统计局工业生产指数。

reason.en: Defined in the indicator registry with no admitted observations; company announcements are not a statistical series.
reason.zh: 指标库已有定义但无已收录观测值；企业公告不构成统计序列。

not_held.en: Industrial production or value added by detailed activity (for example NACE C27 batteries or C29 vehicles)
not_held.zh: 按细分行业的工业产量或增加值（如 NACE C27 电池、C29 汽车）

not_held.en: Public support paid to individual investors (State aid amounts by project)
not_held.zh: 向单个投资者支付的公共支持（按项目的国家援助金额）
按工厂或项目的就业人数

research_questions.en: Which stages of a strategic investment does the official record document, and which rest only on company statements?
research_questions.zh: 官方记录记载了战略投资的哪些阶段，哪些只依据企业表述？

research_questions.en: Which government instruments (designation, budget, permit) were adopted for a project, on which dates, and by which institution?
research_questions.zh: 为某项目通过了哪些政府工具（认定、预算、许可），在何日、由哪个机构作出？

research_questions.en: What do national and regional manufacturing indicators show over the same period, and why can a single plant not be read from them?
research_questions.zh: 同期全国和区域制造业指标呈现什么情况，为什么无法从中读出单个工厂的作用？

limitations.en: National manufacturing and production aggregates cannot isolate one plant; no plant-level output statistic is held.
limitations.zh: 全国制造业和生产总量无法分离单个工厂；Atlas 不持有工厂层面的产出统计。

limitations.en: A permitted capacity is an upper limit set by an authority, not production.
limitations.zh: 许可产能是主管机关设定的上限，不是实际产量。

title.en: Foreign direct investment and production networks
title.zh: 外商直接投资与生产网络

description.en: Balance-of-payments direct-investment flows and the trade and manufacturing series that describe production networks, read alongside documented acquisitions, licences and investment projects without merging project amounts into the official flows.
description.zh: 国际收支直接投资流量以及描述生产网络的贸易与制造业序列，与有记录的收购、许可和投资项目对照阅读，但不把项目金额并入官方流量。

role.en: Direct-investment liabilities, net incurrence (BPM6, all entities including special-purpose entities).
role.zh: 直接投资负债净发生额（BPM6，全部实体，含特殊目的实体）。

role.en: Exports of goods and services, national accounts (P6).
role.zh: 国民账户货物和服务出口（P6）。

role.en: Imports of goods and services, national accounts (P7).
role.zh: 国民账户货物和服务进口（P7）。

role.en: Exports plus imports relative to GDP.
role.zh: 进出口合计占 GDP 比重。

role.en: Share of goods exports going to Germany (UN Comtrade).
role.zh: 对德国货物出口占比（UN Comtrade）。

role.en: Motor-vehicle exports as a share of all exports.
role.zh: 汽车出口占全部出口比重。

role.en: SORS monthly goods exports for Serbia, EUR.
role.zh: 塞尔维亚统计局月度货物出口（欧元）。

not_held.zh: 外商直接投资存量（头寸），包括流入和流出

not_held.en: FDI by partner country or by industry
not_held.zh: 按伙伴国或行业划分的外商直接投资
剔除特殊目的实体的外商直接投资

research_questions.en: How do documented acquisitions, licences and project announcements relate in time to the published national direct-investment flows?
research_questions.zh: 有记录的收购、许可和项目公告，与公布的全国直接投资流量在时间上如何对应？

research_questions.en: Which parts of an investment chain (licence, transaction, construction, operation) does each source document?
research_questions.zh: 每个来源记录了投资链条的哪一部分（许可、交易、建设、运营）？

research_questions.en: How do manufacturing and export structures differ across the ten countries in the held series?
research_questions.zh: 在已持有序列中，十国的制造业和出口结构有何差异？

limitations.en: The FDI series covers all resident entities, including special-purpose entities, so large swings can reflect financial restructuring rather than new production capacity.
limitations.zh: FDI 序列覆盖全部常住实体，包括特殊目的实体，因此大幅波动可能反映财务重组，而不是新增产能。

limitations.en: No partner or industry breakdown is held, so a flow cannot be attributed to an investor country or sector.
limitations.zh: 未持有按伙伴国或行业的细分，因此无法把流量归于某一投资来源国或行业。

limitations.en: The canonical (2021 onwards) and historical (before 2021) layers come from different data releases and are never spliced; FDI history before 2021 is held only for Romania, Serbia and Slovakia.
limitations.zh: 规范层（2021 年起）与历史层（2021 年前）来自不同的数据发布版本，从不拼接；2021 年前的 FDI 历史只持有罗马尼亚、塞尔维亚和斯洛伐克的数据。

description.en: Energy-balance dependency, retail electricity prices and consumer energy-price inflation, read alongside documented energy-security measures, price regulation and transition investments. Physical quantities, shares, prices and policy announcements are kept as separate kinds of evidence.
description.zh: 能源平衡依赖度、零售电价和居民能源价格通胀，与有记录的能源安全措施、价格管制和转型投资对照阅读。实物量、比重、价格和政策公告作为不同类型的证据分开保存。

role.en: Net energy imports as a share of gross available energy (energy balance, physical quantities).
role.zh: 能源净进口占可用能源总量比重（能源平衡，实物量）。

role.en: Household electricity price, EUR per kWh, all taxes included.
role.zh: 居民电价，欧元/千瓦时，含全部税费。

role.en: Non-household electricity price, EUR per kWh.
role.zh: 非居民电价，欧元/千瓦时。

role.en: Annual average rate of the HICP energy component.
role.zh: HICP 能源分项年均变化率。

role.en: Monthly year-on-year rate of the HICP energy component.
role.zh: HICP 能源分项月度同比。

role.en: European natural-gas benchmark price (common series, not country-specific).
role.zh: 欧洲天然气基准价格（共同序列，非国别）。

reason.en: Defined in the indicator registry with no admitted observations.
reason.zh: 指标库已有定义，但没有已收录观测值。

not_held.zh: 按电源划分的发电量（发电结构）

not_held.en: Energy intensity and final energy consumption
not_held.zh: 能源强度和终端能源消费

not_held.en: Gas imports by supplier country and gas storage levels
not_held.zh: 按供应国划分的天然气进口和储气水平

research_questions.en: Which energy-security and price measures are documented in each country, and which indicators describe the conditions around them?
research_questions.zh: 各国记录了哪些能源安全与价格措施，哪些指标描述了它们前后的状况？

research_questions.en: How do import dependency and retail electricity prices compare across the ten countries over the held periods?
research_questions.zh: 在已持有期间，十国的进口依赖度和零售电价如何比较？

research_questions.en: What does a documented funding commitment for energy establish, and what would be needed to observe an energy outcome?
research_questions.zh: 有记录的能源资金承诺能证明什么？观测能源结果还需要什么？

limitations.en: Import dependency is a physical energy-balance ratio; it does not distinguish suppliers and is not a measure of import costs.
limitations.zh: 进口依赖度是能源平衡的实物比率，不区分供应来源，也不衡量进口成本。

limitations.en: Electricity prices and HICP energy reflect wholesale markets, taxes and regulation together; a single measure cannot be isolated in them.
limitations.zh: 电价和 HICP 能源分项同时反映批发市场、税费和管制；无法从中分离单一措施。

limitations.en: Monthly HICP energy is held to July 2026, so measures from August 2026 onwards have no post-event observations yet.
limitations.zh: 月度 HICP 能源数据截至 2026 年 7 月，因此 2026 年 8 月起的措施尚无事件后观测值。

description.en: EU financial instruments represented in admitted records — the Recovery and Resilience Facility and its REPowerEU chapters, rural-development funds, the SAFE defence instrument and rule-of-law conditionality — recorded stage by stage, with public-finance and regional series as context only.
description.zh: 已收录记录中涉及的欧盟金融工具——复苏与韧性基金及其 REPowerEU 章节、农村发展基金、SAFE 国防工具和法治条件机制——逐阶段记录，公共财政和区域序列只作背景。

role.en: General government revenue relative to GDP.
role.zh: 广义政府收入占 GDP 比重。

role.en: General government expenditure relative to GDP.
role.zh: 广义政府支出占 GDP 比重。

role.en: General government deficit or surplus relative to GDP.
role.zh: 广义政府赤字或盈余占 GDP 比重。

role.en: Regional GDP per inhabitant, for regions named in funding records.
role.zh: 资金记录中所涉区域的人均 GDP。

reason.en: Defined in the indicator registry with no admitted observations; programme amounts at different stages are not a single series.
reason.zh: 指标库已有定义但无已收录观测值；不同阶段的计划金额不构成单一序列。

not_held.en: Cohesion-policy allocations, payments and absorption by programme
not_held.zh: 按计划划分的凝聚政策额度、付款和吸收

not_held.en: Recovery and Resilience Facility disbursements as a time series
not_held.zh: 复苏与韧性基金拨付的时间序列

not_held.en: Expenditure and completion data for funded projects
not_held.zh: 受资助项目的支出和完成数据
塞尔维亚的 IPA 入盟前援助资金

research_questions.en: At which financial stage does each admitted funding record sit, and which later stages are documented?
research_questions.zh: 每条已收录资金记录处于哪个财务阶段，后续哪些阶段有记录？

research_questions.en: How do loans and grants, and requests and authorisations, differ across the countries' recovery plans?
research_questions.zh: 各国复苏计划中，贷款与赠款、申请与授权有何差别？

research_questions.en: Which public-finance series describe the period, and why can EU transfers not be read from them?
research_questions.zh: 哪些公共财政序列描述了该时期，为什么无法从中读出欧盟转移支付？

limitations.en: No series of EU funds received is held; amounts exist only as stage-specific records.
limitations.zh: Atlas 不持有欧盟资金收入序列；金额只以分阶段记录存在。

limitations.en: How RRF grants are recorded in government revenue follows Eurostat's statistical guidance on the facility, which the Atlas has not admitted; a disbursement date is not assumed to be the date a transfer enters government accounts.
limitations.zh: 复苏与韧性基金赠款如何计入政府收入，取决于 Eurostat 对该基金的统计记录指引，Atlas 尚未收录该指引；不假定拨付日期就是转移支付进入政府账户的日期。

limitations.en: Serbia is not an EU member state; EU-internal programmes are not applicable rather than zero.
limitations.zh: 塞尔维亚不是欧盟成员国；欧盟内部计划对其不适用，而不是记为零。
